label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y si rehúsante tú de enviar, he aquí yo plagante a todo tu límite con las ranas.
spanish: Y si rehúsante tú de enviar, he aquí yo hiriente a todo tu límite con las ranas.
grammarChanges: Replaced "plagante" with "hiriente" for h02008002007 (נֹגֵף, qal active participle): the auditor flagged "plagante" as narrowing the qal participle's generic "striking" sense to a plague-specific blow; "hiriente" keeps the licensed striking sense and preserves the same -ante/-ente participle style as "rehúsante" without adding the plague concept.
